orders.text:
C482 No. 463 of 2020
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J. 
Mr. Pawan Mishra, learned 
counsel for the applicant.
Mrs. Mamta Joshi, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
This matter was initially taken up 
on 18.03.2020. Thereafter, it was 
never listed till filing of the present 
application on 22.12.2020, wherein the 
prayer has been made by the applicant 
for hearing the matter or deciding the 
same on its merits.
It cannot be decided on merits as 
on date because the respondent has 
not yet been noticed. As far as the 
prayer made in the application for 
early hearing for admission, the same 
is allowed.
The C482 application is directed 
to be listed in the week commencing 
08.02.2021 after fresh cases.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
Vacation Judge
 27.01.2021 AK/SB
